name: After § 18
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Serbia
part_text: 18a. Notes that the Serbian people made a clear choice regarding the composition of their government in the parliamentary elections of December 2023; notes that in March 2026, local elections were held in different municipalities; calls for the EU to respect the democratic choice of the Serbian people and to avoid drawing stark contrasts between the different parties; warns that by supporting efforts to overturn a legitimate election result because of dissatisfaction with the outcome, the EU is undermining democracy in Serbia and fuelling polarisation and instability;
